Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the symbol of the Saints associated with New Orleans is "Sir Saint" rather than the "fleur-de-lis." This error occurred because the Planner did not verify the official symbol/logo of the New Orleans Saints after identifying the headquarters city as New Orleans. The Planner incorrectly associated "Sir Saint" (a retired mascot) as the symbol, instead of the widely recognized and officially used fleur-de-lis, which is the correct answer. This mistake resulted from insufficient verification of the Saints' symbol and reliance on outdated or secondary information.
